## 2. Isogeny-cycle pumps against the best pump-free configuration

The pump's price per bit of height is 2*cost(ell-step)/log2(ell) field multiplications; the doubling it replaces costs DBL_M. A pump can only win if its price per bit is below DBL_M, and even then it must also pay for the extra precomputed tables.
